author: shadow
description: Modern emoji management tools: list all server emojis in yellow embeds with even-per-row layout, download as split zips under 50MB, and move emojis between servers with rate-limit handling and resume support. Public list/download limited to 10 uses per day per server.
install_msg: EmojiPortal loaded. Use [p]emojiportal for help. Anyone can list/download (10/day/server). Staff can move/steal. Requires Manage Expressions for create operations.
short: List, download, and move server emojis safely with daily limits.
